courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 長距離輸水管水錘分析
related.titleEn: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
related.transfer: 可遷移「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」與「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；長距離輸水管水錘分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification" and "Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Water-hammer analysis for long water mains must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦路線、管床、接頭與大管施工階段傳力；長距離輸水管水錘分析則以波傳播、邊界反射與輸水瞬變驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on alignment, bedding, joints and staged load transfer in large mains; Water-hammer analysis for long water mains centres on wave propagation, boundary reflections and water-main transient verification, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「縱斷面與局部壓力」與「穩態水頭基線」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到長距離輸水管水錘分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alignment and local pressure” and “Steady hydraulic baseline”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Water-hammer analysis for long water mains, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「縱斷面與局部壓力」與「漏口能量與聲源形成」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alignment and local pressure” and “Leak energy and acoustic generation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Acoustic leak location in water mains, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大口徑輸水管施工
history.text: 大型輸水工程的知識由管殼設計逐漸延伸到供水韌性與量測校核。美國墾務局壓力管專論的初版於1949年發行，現存修訂版提供歷史機理參照；2020年EPANET手冊則說明配水管網延時分析。紐約於2025年公告德拉瓦繞道須重新採購接通工程，因此本課不將其寫成已完工案例。莫卡辛系統另呈現老舊鋼管與支座更新議題。所有課內算例為獨立假設，未移植上述工程的操作參數。
history.textEn: Knowledge of large water conduits has expanded from shell design to supply resilience and measurement validation. Reclamation first issued its penstock monograph in 1949; its available revision is a historical mechanics reference. The 2020 EPANET manual addresses extended-period distribution modeling. New York announced a new procurement process for Delaware bypass connection in 2025, so this course does not describe it as completed. Moccasin supplies a separate aging-pipe and support-renewal comparison. Every lesson calculation uses independent assumptions rather than operating parameters from those projects.

history.textEn: Reclamation first issues the welded-steel penstock monograph; this is a publication milestone.

history.title: 大口徑輸水管施工

history.textEn: New York announces renewed bypass-connection procurement, retaining supply and construction constraints.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」到「通水體積與分段交接機理與驗證」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Alignment and local pressure mechanism and verification" through "Filling volume and staged handover mechanism and verification" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
